name: microsoft-rewards-bookmark-manager
description: A Chrome extension that automates Microsoft Rewards by creating and managing Bing search bookmarks with unique keywords.

scripts.build:win: tsc && copy src\*.html dist\ && copy src\*.css dist\ && copy src\icon.png dist\ && copy src\manifest.json dist\
scripts.build:unix: tsc && cp src/*.html dist/ && cp src/*.css dist/ && cp src/icon.png dist/ && cp src/manifest.json dist/
scripts.dev: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run watch
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../extension.zip .
